title: Harry and Meghan's media treatment echoes what happened to Diana, Earl Spencer tells BBC
description: Princess Diana's brother describes press coverage of Prince Harry and Meghan as a "cancerous influence in their life" and says he saw his sister cry "tears of despair" over interest in her.

title: Key takeaways from BBC interview as Earl Spencer defends claims about King
description: Earl Spencer speaks to the BBC's Laura Kuenssberg ahead of the publication of his book about his sister Diana, Princess of Wales.

title: Watch: Emotional Earl Spencer says he misses sister Diana every day
description: "This is my swan song too. I'm not here to bang on about Diana, this is my final word, celebration of her", Earl Spencer told presenter Laura Kuenssberg.

title: German Chancellor Merz vows to stay on despite 'disaster' in state election
description: Exit polls show damaging losses for Merz's centre-right CDU party in the states of Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

title: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says
description: Moscow's mayor says 450 drones were downed during the overnight barrage, in which two people died.

title: Ed Davey calls for immediate 10p cut to fuel duty
description: Sir Ed blamed Donald Trump's war with Iran for damaging the UK economy and pushing fuel prices up.

title: Ed Sheeran admits 'mistakes' at first show since Macklemore controversy
description: The singer spoke about Israel and Gaza after Macklemore was dropped from his tour for making pro-Palestinian remarks on stage.

title: Trump says his planned triumphal arch will double as a military complex to store ammunition
description: Trump said the updated plans were at the request of the US military and for national security purposes.

title: Our head teacher was an abuser. We joined forces to get justice - now we're married
description: Students spent years collecting evidence against their Indonesian principal, before falling in love.
